flora: Blunt needle spray (close-up segment of thick, flattened linear needles arranged along a twig)
Pendant seed cone (oval, hanging conifer cone with thick, smooth overlapping woody scales)
Resinous bark plate (macro study of deeply grooved, blocky bark showing a glossy amber sap droplet)
Young conifer shoot (vibrant green, plump seedling emerging vertically with soft embryonic needles)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; look for dense, pillow-like groupings; avoid sharp, razor-thin, spike-like needle rendering; focus on blocky, rounded woody masses and rich tactile surfaces.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a detailed grid view of the comb-like flattened needle arrangement; Top-Right: a solitary woody seed cone hanging vertically; Bottom-Left: a close-up of a blocky bark segment with a clear sap bubble; Bottom-Right: a sturdy young green shoot.
visual_logic.ground: A uniform layer of earthy umber volcanic soil, elevating the dark greens of the conifer elements.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key diffused daylight, illuminating the overlapping layers of the cone and the texturing of the bark without harsh shadows.
